privacy.ai_training_note: Product-dependent. For consumer products (free Le Chat), Input and Output ARE used to train models by default, subject to an in-account opt-out: "Your Input and Output, subject to your opt-out." For business and enterprise tiers, training is OFF: "we do not use your Input and Output to train our artificial intelligence models when you use Le Chat Enterprise or the paid version of our APIs." In-app 'thumbs up/down' Feedback (plus associated Input/Output) is used for training as Controller regardless of tier. When Mistral acts as data processor for business customers, the Privacy Policy does not apply and the DPA governs.
privacy.data_region: EU by default ("Our servers are hosted in the EU"). Self-hosted/on-prem and VPC options keep data in the customer environment. A US API region is available (subprocessor Google LLC, Netherlands/United States). International transfers covered by EU Standard Contractual Clauses under Article 46 GDPR.

security.name: Incident disclosure (2026)
security.value: Mini Shai-Hulud third-party supply-chain attack (May 2026) compromised non-core code repos and poisoned npm/PyPI SDK packages (mistralai 2.4.6). Mistral states hosted services, managed user data, and research/testing environments were NOT compromised. Disclosed transparently with public incident report MAI-2026-002.

security.name: Zero data retention (ZDR)
security.value: Available on APIs; otherwise paid API Input/Output retained 30 rolling days for abuse monitoring unless ZDR activated

products.name: Le Chat (consumer / free + Pro)
products.data_scope: Mistral is data controller. Input/Output used to train models BY DEFAULT, opt-out available in account. Memory feature may store sensitive Input (with explicit consent). Conversations kept until deleted or account deletion.
products.notes: Personal-use tier under the Privacy Policy; not for processing data in a business context.

products.name: Le Chat Enterprise
products.data_scope: No model training on Input/Output. Mistral acts as processor under the DPA; customer is controller.
products.notes: Suitable for business data; covered by DPA + SCCs.

products.name: Studio / La Plateforme (API)
products.data_scope: Paid API: no model training. Input/Output retained 30 rolling days for abuse monitoring unless zero data retention enabled. Agents API retains until account termination; Fine-Tuning API retains tuning data until deleted.
products.notes: EU-hosted by default; US API region available via Google subprocessor.

products.name: Forge
products.data_scope: Train, align, evaluate custom models on proprietary data; customer-controlled.
products.notes: Enterprise domain adaptation, RL/distillation, synthetic data.

products.name: Vibe / Vibe for Code
products.data_scope: Long-horizon agent with persistent memory and tool/connector access; connected third-party services are not used for model training.
products.notes: Separate Vibe Terms of Service apply at chat.mistral.ai.

products.name: Compute / Self-hosted Studio
products.data_scope: Self-hosted on VPC, edge, or on-premises: "Your data stays within your walls." No data leaves customer environment.
products.notes: Highest control tier; also available via cloud partners (AWS, Azure, GCP, IBM, SAP, Snowflake, NVIDIA, Outscale).

compare.pricing_model: Freemium consumer (Le Chat free/Pro) + usage-based API pricing + enterprise/commercial contracts + self-managed compute
compare.data_residency: EU-default (EU-hosted servers); self-hosted/on-prem and VPC options; optional US API region; SCCs for restricted-country transfers

flags: Consumer/free Le Chat trains on user Input/Output BY DEFAULT (opt-out exists); business, enterprise, and paid API tiers do NOT train. Directory should not present a single training answer for the whole vendor.
In-app thumbs-up/down Feedback (plus associated Input/Output) is used for model training as Controller across tiers per the DPA.

May 2026 third-party supply-chain incident (Mini Shai-Hulud) poisoned published npm/PyPI SDK packages (mistralai 2.4.6); Mistral states hosted services and user data were unaffected and disclosed it transparently.
No public bug bounty (HackerOne/Bugcrowd) program identified; disclosure is via trust@mistral.ai and published advisories.
